name: Concord Custom Furniture
old_description: Fueling his ambition, Jeff founded Concord Custom Furniture LLC, aiming to offer a personal and tailored experience for each customer. With a commitment to using the finest specialty woods, the company endeavors to craft the ideal furniture piece that perfectly complements your home or office. Connect with Jeff today to begin the journey of creating your very own custom masterpiece!
about:
Concord Custom Furniture operates from Concord, New Hampshire. The company was founded by Jeff Labrecque, who established the business to provide a personal and tailored experience for each customer, with a commitment to using the finest specialty woods.

The shop produces bespoke furniture pieces, ranging from traditional to contemporary designs, each meticulously handcrafted. Processes include custom design, woodworking, hand assembly, and finishing, with a focus on specialty wood selection. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

The company serves both residential and commercial clients, creating custom pieces for homes and offices. A recent testimonial highlights a craft table built for a family, illustrating the residential focus, while the mention of office spaces indicates commercial work.

Labrecque started the business to deliver a personalized experience and to craft furniture that reflects the client's unique style. The company emphasizes passion, attention to detail, and the use of premium specialty woods as its defining qualities.
